decision.rule: This is a fixed-candidate historical reproduction, not an independent validation or a new parameter search. Pre-tax ROI is primary and tax is secondary. Any apparent positive needs a separate strict independent EV; no purchase, production, betting or promotion is authorized.

input_boundary: Reads only accepted #151 Gate-A fixed candidate/plans, canonical final-SP outcomes, and accepted #148 settled aggregate curve for descriptive side-by-side reporting. No candidate identity, Q vector, M, seed, stake, sampler or selection rule is recomputed. An issue missing any canonical role outcome remains unavailable at zero executed stake; no partial or substitute settlement is used.
metrics: Pre-tax ROI primary; outputs include candidate, same-K4 FULL and candidate-minus-FULL, dense M surface, seed/YEAR/FOLD/LOYO/bootstrap, concentration, largest issue, stake distribution, duplicate/coverage and #148 side-by-side curve.

outcome_completeness.rule: Complete issue settlement only; unavailable rows have zero executed stake and remain in every M/seed/arm denominator.

sampling: WR is primary and retains each independent duplicate draw as its own ¥2 ticket; WOR is the fixed #137-candidate sensitivity; FULL is exact enumeration.
scope: historical paper research only; no purchase, production, betting, or promotion authority.
streaming: Issue rows are written once. A stage-local SQLite index provides bounded-memory summaries and bootstrap, then is omitted after its published CSV/gzip controls are materialized; no /tmp path is used.
tax: Tax is secondary and assessed per individual winning ticket only: 20% iff that ticket gross is at least ¥10,000. No issue/policy/identity aggregation can create tax.
